evals.name: vibe-coding-hidden-workflow
evals.prompt: Research today's overlooked coding-agent or vibe-coding workflows. Prefer concrete techniques around Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes, skills, MCP, context engineering or agent harnesses. Do not fill the result with mainstream model launches.
evals.expected_output: A small set of novel practical coding-agent findings, each traced to technical evidence, with generic launch/model chatter excluded.
assertions: At least one finding is a reproducible coding-agent workflow, tool, integration, skill, harness or context technique.
Important technical claims point to primary evidence such as a repository, issue, PR, commit, documentation or first-party release.
The result is not dominated by generic model announcements or benchmark news.
The report explains why each surviving finding is useful and new rather than listing links only.

evals.name: monero-community-to-primary-evidence
evals.prompt: Find a recent technically meaningful Monero or privacy development. Use community sources such as Reddit/X for discovery when useful, but verify the strongest claim against primary technical evidence.
evals.expected_output: A Monero/privacy finding with a visible discovery-to-verification chain and explicit confidence/caveats.
assertions: The finding is about Monero/privacy engineering, not coin price speculation.
A community/social discovery signal is not treated as independent proof by itself.
The central claim is checked against project-owned code, issue/PR/commit, documentation, paper or first-party announcement when available.
Contradictions or verification limits are stated instead of hidden.

evals.name: x-fallback-remains-mandatory
evals.prompt: Run the X research lane while the first X mirror is unavailable. Continue X discovery through configured fallback routes and report access failures honestly.
evals.expected_output: X remains in the research surface using fallback mirrors/search paths; failure of one transport does not silently remove X.
assertions: Failure of the first mirror is recorded as a limitation.
Another configured X route is attempted before declaring X unavailable.
Mirror copies of the same X post are canonicalized as one candidate/source identity.
Important X-discovered technical claims are followed to primary evidence when possible.

evals.name: reddit-rss-broad-intake-selective-depth
evals.prompt: Use Reddit to discover coding-agent and Monero/privacy developments with enough breadth for a daily frontier run. Use RSS/Atom for intake and selectively deep-read only the strongest threads/comments.
evals.expected_output: Broad RSS candidate coverage with dedupe, source diversity and limited deep reading rather than hundreds of full-thread model reads.
assertions: RSS/Atom is used as cheap intake rather than as the final evidence layer.
Candidate URLs are canonicalized/deduplicated before coverage accounting.
Only a bounded strongest subset is deep-read.
Useful comment branches can trigger primary-source follow-up.

evals.name: local-llm-noise-is-out-of-scope
evals.prompt: Produce the unknown-frontier research report when the intake includes many LocalLLaMA/local-inference/model-quantization items plus a smaller number of coding-agent and Monero/privacy items.
evals.expected_output: Coding-agent and Monero/privacy items win unless local inference directly changes those workflows; generic LocalLLaMA noise is filtered.
assertions: Generic local-model, quantization and inference-hobby items are not surfaced merely because they are available.
A local-inference item may survive only when it materially improves coding-agent cost, privacy, deployment or workflow.
Vibe-coding/coding-agent and Monero/privacy findings receive higher relevance priority.
The excluded LocalLLaMA source is not automatically re-promoted through source discovery.

evals.name: anchor-saturation-preserves-exploration
evals.prompt: Assume protected anchor feeds alone contain more candidates than the daily target. Select the candidate set without losing adaptive learned sources or new-source exploration.
evals.expected_output: Candidate selection respects anchor/dynamic/explore pools instead of truncating the anchor feed first.
assertions: Protected anchors receive guaranteed candidate budget but do not consume the whole target.
Learned dynamic sources retain a non-zero candidate share when available.
Query-tail/new-source exploration retains a non-zero candidate share when available.
Selection is source-diverse so one prolific account/subreddit cannot monopolize a pool.

evals.name: source-learning-needs-useful-evidence
evals.prompt: A newly discovered source appears in candidateSources but has not yet produced a useful deep-read finding. Later it produces useful evidence-bearing candidates on repeated runs. Apply the source lifecycle.
evals.expected_output: Discovery alone creates probation without hit credit; repeated useful evidence later advances the source through trusted/promoted tiers.
assertions: A candidateSources mention alone does not increment useful-hit count.
The new source starts at probation unless it is an explicit protected anchor.
Repeated useful evidence can advance the source to trusted and then promoted.
User-excluded sources cannot regain promotion through autonomous discovery.
